jobs.name: Mariana
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent conversation portrait of MARIANA, the WOMAN in the top row of reference 2. Reference 1 supplies the approved rounded flat cartoon STYLE; reference 2 supplies her exact IDENTITY. Preserve her warm medium skin, shoulder-length dark brown side-parted rounded hair, large white oval eyes, small round yellow earrings and turquoise top. Centered head and upper shoulders, friendly relaxed smile, front three-quarter view facing slightly right. Complete hair and head inside the canvas with generous transparent margin. Readable at 36px. Rounded geometric shapes, bright flat colors, minimal details, almost no outlines. True transparent background, fully opaque character interiors. No realism, texture, gradients, shadows, disc, frame, ground, hands, props, other people, labels, text or watermark. Exactly ONE portrait, not a sheet or collage.
